finding.title: Reject ill-conditioned planes before shader UV division
finding.fix: Preflight simulates float32 Gram arithmetic and rejects determinants at most 1e-6 times uu*vv, or nonfinite determinants. shaderInput invokes the same validation before constructing a draw input. GLSL visibility arithmetic remains unchanged.
regressions: Near-collinear small-coordinate input fails validateExperiment, referencePixels and shaderInput with ill-conditioned plane.
A less parallel sheared plane remains supported; exactly collinear planes retain the existing degenerate-plane diagnostic.
finding.redRun: New preflight regression failed on the reviewed model because no exception was thrown; 11 other analytic tests passed.
finding.greenRun: All 12 analytic tests pass after the fix.

environment.webglRenderer: ANGLE (Apple, ANGLE Metal Renderer: Apple M5 Pro, Unspecified Version)

rejectedExperiments.approach: Cross-product UV solve, algebraically equivalent to the inverse Gram solve.
rejectedExperiments.result: Rejected: existing thin-plane CPU oracle versus pinned software still differed by up to 127 bytes at half-open UV boundaries. The experiment was reverted; neither CPU oracle nor frozen references was changed.
